notes.title: Fixed giving Grandmeow multiple packages and a little achievement update :)
notes.content:
We fixed the issue of being able to give Grandmeow multiple packages (even Gingy's package) so she now only gets one! 

We also updated the Bread achievement so you can start the oven, go and do other things like kick more cans or find more ducks instead of having to stay at the oven :)

Hope you have fun!

notes.title: Updates to Achievement and fixing soft lock
notes.content:
You can now get the "Toast" achievement after 15 minutes instead of 50 minutes! (Cats can't count anyway, right..?)

We've also fixed the issue where players can get soft locked inside the Post Office at night time by limiting access once you leave the Post Office :) 

Hope you all have fun!

notes.title: Catto's Post Office launches August 4th!
notes.content:
[p][b]save the date! mark your calendars! [i]meow meow meow[/i]! [/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Catto's Post Office launches [u]AUGUST 4TH[/u]![/b]

[/h2][previewyoutube="xQex8Li7Bvo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2908050/Cattos_Post_Office/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]we're so thrilled that we can finally share this release date with you all! we can't believe we're about to launch a video game!!

our studio was formed through a united love for cats and creating games. we wanted to make a short and cozy game for everyone to enjoy in their downtime and thought, "who doesn't love cats?!?" as a result, we've poured our hearts into making Catto's Post Office - and very soon you'll get to play it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048941/fcaa9f6abea8a2c236d88b83f5eada88ba7d7ddc.gif"][/img][/p][h3] 
[b]here's why we're excited for Catto's Post Office! ^•⩊•^ [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]🏠 Charming Open World - [/b]explore a vibrant cat-themed town with buildings you can enter (like a bakery, a florist, a cafe, and more). check out the whimsical theming (pawprints on doors! cat-shaped rubber duckies!) and see what easter eggs you can discover (for example, there are only cat-friendly plants and flowers in town!!)  

[b]💌 Deliver Packages and Make Friends -[/b] make deliveries around town and meet eccentric kitty residents as you go. assist your new feline friends by completing silly tasks and unravel funny conversations with multiple dialogue choices. who will become your favorite character?!

🐱 [b]Everybody Wants to Be a Cat -[/b] meow whenever you want! hide inside boxes! knock over plant pots, cans, and even more besides! did we mention you can meow whenever you want? seriously, meow whenever you want. (meow.)

[b]🎂 A Wholesome Narrative Adventure -[/b] it's Catto's birthday and nobody's remembered - oh no! be whiskered away by this heartwarming tale about a hardworking Postcat who learns just how valued he is by the friends he helps out every day :’)

[b]🍬 Short and Sweet -[/b] taking only 1 hour to complete, this is the perfect snackable experience to snuggle up with for an afternoon or play in small bursts![/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048941/7dd7d4d8fc0ec5e5ee339231186a0b6ee39084b9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048941/be3da3e09fe97bc3d6ab997956f25b45fee1e377.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048941/a0ee926a9f967425cc6d2bbed619cea41ef6efd7.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]if you haven't already, [b]please wishlist the game[/b] - it really helps us out!

and [b]spread the word about our release date! [/b]anything you can do to share the news would truly mean the world to us![/p][p]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2908050/Cattos_Post_Office/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]see you all on [u]August 4th[/u]![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]in shambles studio ~[/i][/p][p][i]
  [/i][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048941/43514b1069f8332575120f20ef098f7f3691e4da.png"][/img][/p]
